e.title: Burning Cost Examples
e.summary: burning-cost 生态官方端到端示例（Colab 免安装）：DML 因果/Conformal/公平性/漂移监测实战
e.body: burning-cost-examples（burning-cost 官方）是 burning-cost 精算库生态的端到端示例仓库：每个 notebook 自包含（装依赖+生成合成数据+拟合模型+对标标准精算方法），提供 Colab 免安装版（30 分钟总览：DML 因果效应、conformal 区间、漂移监测；快速上手：费率变更评估 DiD/ITS、代理歧视审计、校准漂移）与 Databricks 原生版（5000 保单车险组合跑通保险因果/Conformal/监测三大旗舰库）。对 RIAA：精算数据科学全家桶的零门槛实战入口——配合 [[course]]（免费 12 模块课程）与 [[insurance-causal]]、[[insurance-conformal]]、[[insurance-monitoring]]、[[insurance-fairness]] 各库；对标 [[ads-tutorials]]（Wüthrich 教程）。

e.summary_en: Official end-to-end examples for the burning-cost ecosystem (Colab, zero setup): DML causality / conformal / fairness / drift monitoring in practice
e.summary_hk: burning-cost 生態官方端到端示例（Colab 免安裝）：DML 因果/Conformal/公平性/漂移監測實戰
e.body_en: burning-cost-examples (official, burning-cost org) is the end-to-end examples repository for the burning-cost actuarial library ecosystem: every notebook is self-contained (installs dependencies, generates synthetic data, fits models, benchmarks against standard actuarial approaches), and offers Colab zero-setup versions (a 30-minute overview: DML causal effects, conformal intervals, drift monitoring; a quickstart: rate-change evaluation with DiD/ITS, proxy-discrimination audits, calibration drift) plus a Databricks-native starter (a 5,000-policy motor portfolio running through the three flagship libraries — insurance-causal / insurance-conformal / insurance-monitoring). For RIAA: a zero-friction hands-on entry point to the actuarial data-science toolbox — pairs with [[course]] (the free 12-module course) and the libraries [[insurance-causal]], [[insurance-conformal]], [[insurance-monitoring]], [[insurance-fairness]]; comparable to [[ads-tutorials]] (the Wüthrich tutorials).
e.body_hk: burning-cost-examples（burning-cost 官方）是 burning-cost 精算庫生態的端到端示例倉庫：每個 notebook 自包含（裝依賴+生成合成數據+擬合模型+對標標準精算方法），提供 Colab 免安裝版（30 分鐘總覽：DML 因果效應、conformal 區間、漂移監測；快速上手：費率變更評估 DiD/ITS、代理歧視審計、校準漂移）與 Databricks 原生版（5000 保單車險組合跑通保險因果/Conformal/監測三大旗艦庫）。對 RIAA：精算數據科學全家桶的零門檻實戰入口——配合 [[course]]（免費 12 模組課程）與 [[insurance-causal]]、[[insurance-conformal]]、[[insurance-monitoring]]、[[insurance-fairness]] 各庫；對標 [[ads-tutorials]]（Wüthrich 教程）。
